caption: The drawing depicts the bust of a young man or boy with light skin and short brown hair, wearing a dark blue military-style uniform with gold epaulettes and large gold buttons on the chest. The figure's eyes are blue and set wide apart, and the mouth is small with red lips. There are visible cracks across the face and head, giving the appearance of a wooden or plaster sculpture. The bust sits on an ornate, scroll-like base colored gold, with swirling details. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature "Mary E. Humes" and some additional writing appear in the lower right corner.
title: Pilot House Ornament
